body.name: Qhat
body.def: \(\widehat Q_N=\widetilde F_S(\widehat p_N)\) when \(\widehat p_N\in\mathcal U\); otherwise, for every \(c_x\), set \(\widehat Q_N(c_y;c_x)=1/|\mathcal A_Y|\) for every \(c_y\).
body.role: Total estimator of the returned macro-effect functional; the fixed uniform fallback is asymptotically irrelevant on a regular stratum.
